claims: Bill Ackman's Pershing Square Capital Management has launched a combined IPO for Pershing Square USA (PSUS) and Pershing Square Inc. (PS).
The combined IPO targets $5-$10 billion in capital.
The offering is expected to price around April 28, 2026.
The offering lists on the NYSE.
Pershing Square USA (PSUS) is a closed-end fund.
Pershing Square USA (PSUS) targets a concentrated portfolio of 12-15 undervalued North American companies.
Pershing Square Inc. (PS) is the management company.
Pershing Square Inc. (PS) provides public ownership of Pershing Square's investment manager.
Investors receive 20 shares of PS for every 100 shares of PSUS purchased.
PSUS shares are priced at $50 per share.
Pershing Square Capital Management secured $2.8 billion in private placements ahead of the official launch.
PSUS and PS will trade on the New York Stock Exchange.
The underwriters are Citigroup, UBS Investment Bank, BofA Securities, Jefferies, and Wells Fargo Securities.
The combined IPO aims for a permanent capital structure similar to Berkshire Hathaway.
The strategy targets 12-15 large-cap, high-quality, undervalued North American companies.
